title: Indented fence markers are content in spec scans
description: indented fence markers are content in spec scans
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cmd-check-017 and REQ-parser-004 already require CommonMark content treatment of indented markers; the scanners disagreed
acceptance_criteria: a spec with a 4-space-indented fence marker before its export table has its exports read and --fix adds each undocumented export exactly once to the real table
